findings.summary: rows of a batch are published concurrently via Promise.allSettled, so per-aggregate order is not guaranteed at the broker; consumers must rely on data.version for state events (already enforced by createEnvelope)
no max-attempts for outbox rows: permanently failing rows retry every 5 min forever; only the stale ALERT log surfaces them
existing deployed rabbitmq_data volume keeps the old default user and orphaned finance.user.created queues after the switch to definitions; clean up manually
handleMessage is fire-and-forget (void); in-flight deliveries are not drained at shutdown, relying on broker redelivery plus dedupe (safe, just noisy)
